note: Leo Express trains in the mkuran polish_trains GTFS that offer couchettes / sleepers. The feed lumps every LE train under one route_id, so we match by trip_short_name rather than route name. Day trains (Praha–Kraków/Warszawa 410–419) are seating-only and excluded. Back-on-Track uses different commercial numbers (LE 232/235 for Frankfurt–Przemyśl); polylines attach by endpoint city match, not by those labels.
